_comment: Labelled areas approximated as ellipses for PeakNav's overlay. Each area has a name, a type ('island', 'mountain_group', 'region', ... which selects the label colour — see AreaRegistry / LabelRenderer), a centre (lat, lon in degrees), the ellipse semi-axes in kilometres (semiMajorKm along the major axis, semiMinorKm across it), rotationDeg (major axis rotated counter-clockwise from due East, 0 = East/West, 90 = North/South), and peakMeters (elevation of the area's highest point, used to hide it once it drops below the horizon). The ellipse only locates/sizes the area on screen; it is not drawn. Unknown types fall back to a neutral colour. Values are rough — areas are simplified to ellipses on purpose.
